Kuki-Zo Forum Demands President's Rule in Manipur

A Kuki-Zo women's body and forum has demanded the imposition of President's Rule in Manipur, stating that the ongoing crisis is political rather than a security issue. The group asserted that after three years, previous efforts have not yielded results and that a political solution is necessary for the state.
